claims.text: Minto was a descendant of the Masters of Buckland who could trace his ancestry back to Gorbadoc Brandybuck. He was the youngest of the four children of Milo Burrows and Peony Baggins, and when he was five years old he attended Bilbo's famous Birthday Party along with the rest of his family.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Baggins of Hobbiton"
